messages:
pagerbot: PagerDuty page fired: inference-dedicated-eu -> spike of 5xx on /v1/generate. Incident INC-3621. Paging oncall now.
incidentbot: auto-annotate: affected_service=decoder, region=eu, estimated_error_rate=12% · runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/infra/inference-5xx-spike
jen: Ack — jen (oncall). Jumping onto this. Starting bridge, will triage. :headphones: 
sam: I can join bridge in ~5m if you need help, @jen.
jen: ok grabbing quick logs. running: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=decoder -c model-worker --tail=100`
jen: logs show repeated `ERR: upstream connection reset by peer` and lots of `redis timeout` entries. snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:01Z] ERR connection to redis://10.0.5.12:6379 timed out after 1500ms
[2026-03-15T14:02:03Z] WARN kvcache miss spike: 78% -> fallback writeback
[2026-03-15T14:02:04Z] ERR upstream reset while streaming tokens
```
alex: looks like kvcache/redis saturation in eu-dedicated pool. we've seen this pattern when autoscaler lags + client burst. Suggest enabling route fallback to eu-fallback-pool and scale decoder pool.
jen: enabling fallback routing policy now: `/infra/routing set-policy --route /v1/generate --fallback-pool eu-fallback-pool --reason "kv timeout spike"` -> returned `OK`
pagerbot: Alert update: error rate estimate reduced -> 4.3% (5m window).
maya: Can we verify customer impact? Which customers saw errors? I can prep a short PSA once we confirm reduced impact.
jen: quick grep of logs shows most errors from client app keys starting with `acme-` and `beta-`. Sending note to accounts to surface.
sam: If fallback holds, we should consider a short hotfix: increase redis conn pool + bump decoder replicas. I'll queue a canary scale now.
jen: scaled decoder replicas + bumped redis pool size via infra-job (canary). Monitoring metrics.
incidentbot: tag update: priority=P2, escalation=oncall, mitigation=fallback-routing & scale. bridge=https://meet.redwood/incident/INC-3621
jen: status ping — error rate down to 1.2% over 2m. Customer-visible errors nearly cleared. Keeping ownership until stable for 10m.
maya: Drafted PSA: "We're investigating elevated 5xx in EU region impacting /v1/generate for a subset of customers. Mitigation applied; error rates returning to normal. Will follow up with root cause." Want me to send?
jen: please hold until we confirm 10m stable, then send. I'll create follow-up ticket and assign to eng-ml for postmortem.
sam: standing by to assist on postmortem (can look at autoscaler tuning).
jen: closing PD page (ack -> resolve) in 8m if stable. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
pagerbot: PagerDuty update: INC-3621 status: acknowledged by jen.
incidentbot: note: added followup task INFR-7892 (investigate kvcache saturation patterns).
jen: final: error rate baseline restored, rolling back fallback policy to normal routing, marking incident as mitigated. Will open RCA doc tomorrow.
